source.title: A curious application of the Borel-Cantelli Lemmas, a result of Barndorff-Nielsen, and some open problems

needs_review.question_text_raw: That the implication does not hold if m = 2 is shown using a real series and it is an open problem for m >= 3. Some other open problems are also presented and discussed.
